entry.author: City Rail Link
entry.summary:
A dream more than 100 years in the making.
An underground railway beneath the heart of Auckland.
The idea was first proposed in the 1920s. It was debated, delayed, rejected and almost abandoned more than once.
Now it’s real and not far away from AT announcing an opening date.
In Episode 1 of our five-part series on the history of Auckland’s City Rail Link, we look back at the vision that refused to die and the extraordinary engineering challenges that brought it to life — including the remarkable feat of lifting a historic downtown building to make way for New Zealand’s biggest transport infrastructure project.
The journey starts below. You can see the rest of the series on our CRL website. The last two will be also available there shortly.
CityRailLink.co.nz
 
 
At the end of June 2026, City Rail Link Limited achieved practical completion of the CRL Project and has now handed the completed infrastructure – stations and tunnels over to Auckland Transport and KiwiRail as the owners and operators. So this is our final CRL Ltd Tunnel Vision. We've enjoyed bringing you videos about this the country's largest transport infrastructure project  that will transform Auckland and thank you for your kind feedback.
Enjoy your first trip!
